understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through all KA59 levels by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is simultaneously occupied by a selectable piece; a level is only won when all goals are covered at the same time, and the full game is won after completing every level within the step budget.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: The currently controlled piece is the one shown as P (with player.id/player.position). MOVE actions shift the selected piece by one 3-pixel grid cell in the chosen direction unless blocked by walls/boundaries or other objects; some adjacent objects are pushable blocks that can be pushed if immediately in the movement direction. Walls (#) and boundaries can prevent or alter movement and may have inconsistent blocking behavior, so testing moves matters. When multiple selectables exist, CLICK using exact pixel/grid coordinates of a selectable switches control to that piece; other selectables are shown as S. The movement.*_blocked flags are only hints about adjacency and do not guarantee the move will fail.
